# ToneTool

> Free online tone generator and frequency generator. Generate audio signals from 1Hz to 20kHz in your browser.

## What is ToneTool?

ToneTool is a free online audio testing toolkit. Generate precise frequencies, test speakers and headphones, check your hearing, and more — all in your browser with no signup required.

## Key Tools

- **Tone Generator**: Generate sine, square, sawtooth & triangle waves from 1Hz to 20kHz
- **Frequency Generator**: Precise audio signal generation for testing and calibration
- **Online Tone Generator**: Browser-based tone generation with real-time control
- **Sine Wave Generator**: Pure tone generation for audio testing
- **Frequency Sweep Generator**: Sweep through frequency ranges to test speakers
- **Hearing Test**: Check your hearing range online
- **Headphone Test**: Verify left/right balance and audio quality
- **Subwoofer Test**: Test bass response with low frequencies
- **White Noise Generator**: Sleep, focus, and study sounds
- **Binaural Beats**: Focus and meditation frequency tool
- **440Hz / 432Hz Generator**: Reference tones for tuning and comparison
- **Instrument Tuner**: Real-time pitch detection for tuning any instrument
- **Tinnitus Frequency Matcher**: Find your exact tinnitus frequency

## Features

- 1Hz to 20kHz frequency range
- 4 waveform types: sine, square, sawtooth, triangle
- Real-time frequency and volume control
- Works on mobile devices
- No signup, no download, 100% free
- WAV download support
